service.name: Name
service.alive_command_help: Exit code 0 indicates Running, non-zero indicates Stopped
service.alive_command_tooltip:
Alive check command runs in the background via remote SSH. State is determined by exit code: 0 for Running (green), non-zero for Stopped (gray).
Common examples:
• Process: pgrep -f "app" >/dev/null
• Port: ss -tln | grep -q :8080
• HTTP: curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/health >/dev/null
• Systemd: systemctl is-active <unit>
• Docker: docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' <container>
